title: Microsoft 365 Conditional Access through Source IP Anchoring
aliases: entra id conditional access named locations

prose.text: Microsoft 365 Conditional Access policies that trust a set of source IP ranges see Zscaler addresses, not corporate ones, once sign-ins go through Internet & SaaS. Source IP Anchoring is the vendor's answer for that use case, and this subject walks it end to end.

steps.label: Why is it needed?
steps.text: The vendor's use case: [[zia.saas-apps.conditional-access:ca-use-case]] Without anchoring, the sign-in arrives from a shared Public Service Edge address: [[zia.saas-apps.conditional-access:shared-edge-ips-fail-named-location]] With it, the destination sees the App Connector's address: [[zia.forwarding-control.sipa:purpose]]

steps.label: What has to be anchored?
steps.text: Only the sign-in: [[zia.saas-apps.conditional-access:anchor-login-only]] The segment names the Microsoft sign-in hosts: [[zia.saas-apps.conditional-access:login-hosts]] {{narrow-scope}}

steps.label: How is it configured?
steps.text: The Private Access and Internet & SaaS steps, and where the Microsoft 365 article departs from the general one: [[shared.m365.sipa-setup]].

steps.label: Why does a sign-in still get challenged or blocked?
steps.text: Failure paths, and the Microsoft-side behavior no captured source settles: [[shared.m365.troubleshooting]].

items.label: Licensing.
items.text: [[zia.forwarding-control.sipa:licensing]] What the API returns when anchoring is configured without the subscription is open {{gap:missing-subscription-error}}.

items.label: Segment settings that exclude anchoring.
items.text: Double Encryption: [[zpa.app-segments.settings:double-encryption-exclusions]] Inspect Traffic with ZIA: [[zpa.app-segments.settings:sipa-inspect-zia-exclusive]] Multimatch: [[zpa.app-segments.multimatch-requirements:sipa-health-reporting]] Whether Browser Access excludes it too is open: [[zpa.app-segments.settings:sipa-browser-access]].

items.label: Other stable-address paths.
items.text: Whether a Cloud Connector (ECZPA) gateway or a Dedicated IP gateway can stand in for the App Connector here is open {{gap:other-anchors}}. Dedicated IP is a separate forwarding method: [[zia.forwarding-control.methods:dedicated-ip-gateway]], [[zia.forwarding-control.byoip:not-sipa]].

items.label: Disaster recovery.
items.text: While Internet & SaaS is in disaster recovery mode, the admin changes the anchoring configuration to Source IP Anchoring Direct and reverts it afterwards: [[zia.forwarding-control.sipa-direct:definition]], [[zia.forwarding-control.sipa-direct:revert-rules]]

Whether the tenant holds the Source IP Anchoring subscription, and whether the segment carries a setting that excludes anchoring.

narrow-scope.statement: With the anchored segment limited to the Microsoft sign-in hosts, the application traffic that follows sign-in does not take the anchored path through the App Connector.
narrow-scope.conditions: Follows from the segment naming only the sign-in hosts; the legacy rationale that this reduces App Connector load and latency is not measured in any source.

other-anchors.title: Whether a Cloud Connector or Dedicated IP path can anchor Microsoft 365 sign-ins
other-anchors.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "The following cannot serve as SIPA anchors: Zscaler Cloud Connector ... The forwarding method for Cloud Connector deployments is ECZPA, not ZPA. ECZPA does not implement SIPA ... Dedicated IP gateway (ENATDEDIP) ... provides a stable customer-attributable IP, it is a distinct product from SIPA ... requires a separate ZIA Dedicated IP SKU ... Branch connector or SD-WAN path — these are not SIPA egress paths." The gateway object has an ECZPA type for Cloud Connector (zia.forwarding-control.zpa-gateway:fields), and Dedicated IP is its own forwarding method, but no capture says whether either produces a source address a Conditional Access named location can trust.
other-anchors.blocks: recommending an alternative to App Connector anchoring for workloads or tenants without the subscription

missing-subscription-error.title: What the API returns when anchoring is configured without the Source IP Anchoring subscription
missing-subscription-error.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Operators who encounter licensing questions or API `400` errors when configuring SIPA forwarding rules should verify that the tenant has the SIPA add-on, not just ZPA." No captured source states the error a tenant without the subscription receives.
